bio.introText: Hi, I'm Tayfun. I'm a junior full-stack developer passionate about building scalable and user-focused web applications using React, JavaScript, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.

skills.skillDetails: Modern web application development, state management, and component-based architecture.
Modern JavaScript features, async/await, DOM manipulation, and API integration.
Responsive design, modern UI development, and utility-first CSS framework usage.
RESTful API development, Spring Security, and JWT authentication implementation.
Database design, relational database management, and ORM usage.
Architectural design, endpoint optimization, and API security.
Version control, branch management, and collaborative development.
Agile methodologies, SOLID principles, and clean code practices.
Unit and integration testing with JUnit, Jest, and Cypress.

content: I'm a Junior Full Stack Developer dedicated to crafting scalable, user-friendly web applications using React, JavaScript, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.

After completing an intensive 960-hour full-time development program, I built real-world projects from the ground up—ranging from secure REST APIs and responsive UIs to a Bluetooth-enabled LED matrix display using ESP32 and Unity.

With a background in Biomedical Engineering, I bring analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a passion for clean, maintainable code to every project. I thrive in collaborative teams and Agile environments, and I'm always eager to grow through hands-on development challenges.

projectList.projectDesc: A secure RESTful API developed with Spring Boot and PostgreSQL. Includes role-based JWT authentication, product/order/review management and modular architecture.
A Java console app for managing books and members. Includes CRUD operations, fee calculation, and role-based logic for librarians and readers.
A personal portfolio built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite. Supports dark mode and bilingual content (English/Turkish).
Bluetooth-controlled LED matrix animations with ESP32 and Unity mobile app. Real-time scrolling text and over 15 custom animations.

footer.collabHeader: Let's work together on your next product.
